business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Supply of Drummed and Bagged Penetration Grade Bitumen

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Ley 526 de 1999 (as amended); Ley 1121 de 2006; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1068 de 2015; Circular Externa 005 de 2018 (Superintendencia Financiera); Circular Básica Jurídica de la Superintendencia de Sociedades; Resolution of the UIAF creating the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Acta Constitutiva) and S.A.S. Bylaws
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public and Cámara de Comercio

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
Notarized Power of Attorney for Pre-Incorporation Proceedings
Certified Copies of Passports for Shareholders, Directors, and Ultimate Beneficial Owners
Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
Tax Due Diligence Certificate or Tax Residency Certificate of Foreign Shareholders

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic screening standards: all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs must be screened against (i) the UIAF's consolidated terrorist and money-laundering list, (ii) the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, (iii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, (iv) the Colombian government's consolidated terrorist list under Decreto 1068 de 2015, (v) the FATF high-risk jurisdictions list, and (vi) the EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence applies to PEPs with a 12-month post-employment cooling-off period. Results must be documented in a KYC/AML dossier and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social via Cámara de Comercio of Bogotá (https://www.rues.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Spanish using Latin script; only Spanish alphabet characters, numerals, and corporate tokens such as 'S.A.S.' are allowed. Foreign words must be transliterated, translated, or adapted to Spanish without accents that conflict with registry rules. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, trademark, or reserved name, and must accurately reflect the permissible corporate form.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a written recurso de reposición with the competent Cámara de Comercio within ten (10) business days. If the rejection is maintained, an recurso de apelación may be filed before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten (10) business days. Alternatively, the applicant may simultaneously reserve a different name. Where the Superintendencia fails to issue a decision within thirty (30) business days, the applicant may proceed with a revised name application. The same process applies to homologación proceedings against confusingly similar registered names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for an S.A.S. engaged in international bitumen trading as a registered commercial address for official and judicial correspondence, provided the statutory domicile is physically verifiable and corporate books are maintained in a physical or locally hosted electronic format accepted by the Cámara de Comercio. The fiscal address registered in the RUT with DIAN must reflect a place where the legal representative and operations can be reached; a virtual office is acceptable if supported by an authorization letter from the space provider and filed with the registry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% – Low/Medium Probability; unannounced inspections may occur for UBO-registry accuracy, commercial substance, and AML/CFT compliance, particularly when foreign shareholders beneficially own more than 50% of the capital or the registered address is a virtual office.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search, availability, and homologation certificate (Cámara de Comercio)
Pre-incorporation AML/KYC and UBO enhanced due diligence screening (PEP, OFAC, UN, Colombia)
Translation, notarization, and apostille of foreign corporate documents and passport copies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Notary and Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. articles of incorporation, bylaws, and incorporation minutes
Certification and notarial execution of the incorporation deed (escritura pública)
Commercial registration with Cámara de Comercio and issuance of Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff based on capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-RUT tax pre-registration filing with DIAN and request for tax identification number (NIT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory government fee; professional handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of final beneficial owner information (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF)
Registered office address and virtual correspondence services (initial three-month term)
Tax and legal capacity opinion for ISIC 4661 bitumen/asphalt wholesale trading (no statutory license required)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Arts. 1, 4, 5, 17, 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 98–120 and 372–374; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES registration rules); Decreto 1076 de 2015 (environmental rules applicable to ancillary storage).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá or Cali), operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) under Confecámaras.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument with notarized or Chamber-authenticated signatures) filed under Law 1258/2008, Art. 5.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital: an S.A.S. fixes subscribed capital freely in the by-laws, payable within two years of incorporation (Law 1258/2008, Art. 4). No escrow account is mandated. Recommended subscribed capital for bitumen wholesale: COP 200,000,000 (≈ USD 50,000) to support Swift LC/TT settlement lines.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The authorized, subscribed, and paid-in capital is acknowledged as stated in the Articles of Incorporation, and the subscription list is ratified; (2) the registered office is fixed at [City], Colombia, and the Legal Representative is empowered to execute the office/storage lease and to notify any change of domicile to the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN; (3) [Full Name], holding ID No. [___], is appointed Legal Representative and General Manager with sole signature power; (4) the Legal Representative is authorized to open corporate bank accounts for SWIFT LC and wire collections, to register the Company for municipal industry-and-commerce tax, and to sign tax filings; (5) all acts performed before this meeting are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Homonymy Certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio — RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES portal, complete the pre-registration homonymy form, and file up to five proposed corporate names bearing the 'S.A.S.' suffix. The Chamber verifies each candidate against the national registry; if unique, it issues a positive homonymy certificate valid for 90 calendar days, reserving the name exclusively for the incorporating parties.
required_dossiers: Valid government-issued ID (cédula de ciudadanía or passport) of each founder/shareholder
Completed RUES pre-registration and homonymy form (Formulario de Homonimia)
Up to five proposed corporate names with the 'S.A.S.' suffix
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a conflicting or confusingly similar name is detected, resubmit a new application with additional alternative names; the denial notice identifies the conflicting registrations. Re-filing within 10 business days is exempt from additional tariff fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public or Cámara de Comercio legalization desk (autenticación de firmas)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the by-laws (estatutos) complying with Law 1258/2008, Art. 17: corporate name with 'S.A.S.' suffix, registered office, corporate purpose (wholesale of drummed and bagged penetration-grade bitumen — ISIC 4661), share capital and classes, indefinite duration, representation clauses, and audit provisions. All shareholders execute the instrument; signatures are authenticated before a notary or the Chamber's legalization desk.
required_dossiers: Final draft of the Documento Privado de Constitución (Articles of Incorporation) under Law 1258/2008, Art. 5
Positive homonymy certificate (name reservation)
ID copies of all shareholders; for foreign shareholders, proof of immigration status or notarized power of attorney
By-laws detailing corporate purpose, capital, share classes, and legal representative powers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber issues a devolution notice (nota devolutiva) for deficient clauses, correct the instrument by a private reform document and re-present within 30 days without penalty; for notarial rejection, re-execute before a different notary at no additional government charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Issuance of Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio — Registro Mercantil (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed and authenticated incorporation instrument together with the registration forms and payment of the tariff. The Chamber verifies legality, registers the company in the Registro Mercantil, issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, and automatically transmits the data to DIAN and the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
required_dossiers: Executed and authenticated Documento Privado de Constitución
Original positive homonymy certificate
Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (matrícula mercantil) and municipal ICA registration form
Payment voucher for registration tariff and official bulletin fees
Identification of the legal representative (cédula copy) and fingerprint registration card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended or rejected, file a written reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) before the Registry Division of the Chamber; if tariff miscalculation caused the rejection, the excess is refunded or offset and the registration is reinstated upon correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration with DIAN (RUT and NIT Issuance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (www.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) form at DIAN's service center or online portal, selecting the tax obligations applicable to a wholesale company (corporate income tax, VAT, withholding at source, and electronic invoicing). The NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) is assigned immediately upon successful validation; activate electronic invoicing within the statutory deadline.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued in Step 3
Formulario de Registro Único Tributario (RUT pre-registration)
Legal representative's identification document
Proof of fixed business address and jurisdiction (utility bill or lease agreement)
Corporate bank account details if required for electronic invoicing validation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File an online RUT correction through the 'Actualización RUT' service if DIAN assigns incorrect tax obligations; if an erroneous NIT is generated, request administrative annulment at the DIAN customer service office with supporting documents, typically resolved within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Operational Start-Up: Municipal ICA Registration, Banking and Employer Social Security Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría de Hacienda Municipal (ICA), commercial banks, and ARL/EPS administrators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the municipal Registro de Industria y Comercio for ICA assessment; open the corporate bank account presenting the certificate of existence and NIT, with beneficial-owner declarations for AML purposes; if personnel are hired, register as employer with EPS and ARL administrators and adopt the SG-SST program under Decree 1072/2015. Foreign equity participation exceeding USD 500,000 must be reported to the Banco de la República.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and NIT/RUT certificate
Copy of by-laws evidencing legal representative powers
Municipal ICA registration forms and land-use (uso de suelo) certificate, if required
Bank account opening forms with beneficial-owner declaration
Employer registration forms with EPS and ARL administrators if hiring staff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal treasury rejects the ICA activity code, submit ISIC 4661 supporting documentation and the Chamber certificate describing wholesale trading; for banking delays, provide a renewed certificate of existence to evidence no liens; ICA arrears, if any, are settled by voluntary declaration with interest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MINCIT) — no industrial manufacturing license applies to pure wholesale distribution; municipal Secretaría de Hacienda administers the Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA) — mandatory municipal registration for wholesale trading; no sectoral industrial operating or manufacturing permit is required for containerized/drummed bitumen trading under Colombian law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA — Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales; regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for lower-tier permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III — environmental registration / Certificado de No Requerimiento de Licencia Ambiental for containerized wholesale distribution without permanent storage; a full EIA is mandated only where fixed hydrocarbon storage exceeds 10,000 US gallons (Decree 1076 of 2015, Art. 2.2.2.3.2.3).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge: pH 6.0–9.0, total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, total petroleum hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/L (Resolution 0631/2015); air quality: VOC fugitive controls per Resolution 2254/2017; contaminated drums, rags, and sludge must be handled as hazardous waste under Decree 1076/2015, Title 9.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate) covering warehouse and drum storage zones per NFPA 30 and Colombian RETIE; structural load inspection certificate for storage areas (Decree 945/2019); occupational health and safety program (SG-SST) registered under Decree 1072/2015 with mandatory ARL affiliation and worker exposure controls for bitumen fume and heat during handling.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), through the Muisca and DIAN Virtual Portals
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must engage a Colombian legal representative or local attorney in fact to register at the DIAN through the Muisca portal. The applicant must upload the entity's constitutive documents (bylaws or equivalent), evidence of legal existence from the home jurisdiction with apostille or consular legalization, power of attorney, and proof of a local address for tax domicile. Assignment of a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) is issued once the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) is approved, including the applicable tax responsibilities such as IVA and ICA (industry and commerce tax) where required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in Colombia. A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is mandatorily treated as a tax-resident corporation under Colombian tax law, taxed on worldwide income at the entity level. No general hybrid mismatch or entity classification election is available; some elective mechanisms exist only for specific regimes such as holding companies (sociedades holding colombianas) under certain conditions and for consolidated or group filing regimes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax with national consumption tax features)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Persons making taxable sales or rendering taxable services in the previous calendar year exceeding 3,500 UVT are required to register and be responsible for IVA (2024 UVT equals COP 47,065, thus a threshold of approximately COP 164,727,500). Importers and exporters must generally register regardless of turnover where they operate in international traffic.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Under DIAN Resolution 165/2023 and related rulings, all registered persons must issue electronic invoices (factura electrónica de venta) through DIAN-authorized software or a free DIAN tool. Invoices must be transmitted to DIAN before issuance and must obtain prior validation through a numerical authorization, status 'validated' and the assigned CUFE/CUDE digital identifier. Digital stamping and mandatory real-time or pre-clearance validation apply to sales, export invoices, and support documents; API-based integration with DIAN's electronic invoicing environment is mandatory for in-house or ERP billing systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods are taxed at 0% IVA, including the export of containerized drummed or bagged bitumen. Zero rating applies when the sale meets the legal definition of export under the Customs Regime (Decree 1165/2019), including definitive export from Colombian customs territory, payment in foreign currency where applicable, and the goods leaving Colombia. Offshore services rendered to foreign users may also be zero-rated when performed entirely outside Colombian territory or used exclusively abroad, subject to the 'offshore services' requirements in the IVA statute.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) accepted by DIAN customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing the goods leaving Colombian customs territory
RUT and export invoice (factura de exportación) with CUFE/CUDE validation
Packing list and weight/volume certificate for containerized bitumen
Inward Remittance Certificate (certificado de cobro de divisas /Foreign Exchange Certificate) as required by Banco de la República
Documentary evidence of receipt in the destination market where applicable under the DEX regime
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under Article 481 and related provisions of the Colombian Tax Statute, exporters must substantiate the actual export through DIAN customs records and evidence of foreign exchange repatriation. Restitution of the global differential (IVA difference at 19%) plus interest is assessed when zero-rated exports are grounded in false declarations, evasive documentation schemes, or non-compliant customs formalities. Penalties include a fine equivalent to 10% or 20% of the invoiced value for irregularly claimed export refunds (Articles 647 and 648 of the Tax Statute), potential indictment for tax fraud under Criminal Law 599/2000, the cancellation of export certification, and the retrospective clawback of VAT refunds for up to the statute of limitations period (generally 5 years; extended to 10 years for unregistered transactions or non-declared operations).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank of Colombia); foreign exchange (FX) regulation is issued by its Junta Directiva under Law 9 of 1991 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. Enforcement is shared with the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) for trade declarations and export-proceeds checks, and with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for supervised Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMCs).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian Peso (COP) is fully convertible under a managed-float regime. Current-account transactions (trade, services, transfers) are free from prior license requirements, and capital-account entries (foreign direct investment, external loans, portfolio flows) are admitted subject to mandatory ex-post registration with the Banco de la República through authorized IMCs. No capital-control hurdles block routine trade: the practical constraints are the TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) daily conversion rule, the FX declaration forms, and the 5% withholding? - No, I'm drifting into tax. Profit remittance hurdle: dividend/profit remittances by a non-resident shareholder have no FX quota or prior permit; they require (i) the foreign investment to be registered in the Registro Internacional de Inversiones (RII) and (ii) a Formulario No. 4/No. 3 (as applicable) declaration at the paying IMC. Dividend tax withholding (10% standard for non-residents) applies at the bank level but is a tax, not an FX, restriction. Conversion to USD for overseas distribution is executed at the day's TRM without administrative approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia applies a 'channeling' (canalización) rather than a surrender regime. There is no mandatory conversion ratio into COP: exporters may retain USD/EUR proceeds in SFC-approved foreign-currency accounts (cuentas de compensación) or local accounts, provided the funds are channeled through an IMC and declared. Statutory timeline: proceeds from goods exports must be received and channeled within 12 months from the date of the export (fecha de la declaración de exportación), under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 (the former six-month term was extended and standardized to 12 months by Banco de la República). For bitumen (HS 2713) containerized wholesale, the importer's SWIFT remittance must be matched, by wire reference, to the DEX (Declaración de Exportación) filed at DIAN; de minimis relief applies to shipments whose FOB value does not exceed USD 10,000.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente); capital-deposit account via fiduciary vehicle
Operational Account (oficina de comercio exterior, Cuenta Corriente; LC issuance desk)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW (rating: 2/5) for the operating treasury of the Colombian S.A.S. Offshore EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud, Payoneer) are not authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario and cannot legally open COP treasury accounts or receive/deliver export-import proceeds that must be canalizadas through an IMC under Law 9/1991 and Circular DCIN-83. An offshore EMI's local partner bank can only support retail-level transfers; any commercial-use conversion or FX settlement outside a registered IMC creates a sanctionable 'canalización por fuera del mercado cambiario' violation (Resolution 3019/2021, DIAN). EMIs are viable solely for immaterial pre-incorporation expenses and intra-group operational overhead outside Colombia; the logical treasury design isolates such flows from the statutory FX channels.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory requirement for directors to appear physically at a branch: the SFC's JLAA framework (Circular Externa 029/2023, replacing Circular 012/2020) permits remote onboarding through high-assurance video interviews. In practice, Tier-1 banks require one recorded video-conference with the legal representative (representante legal) and any beneficial shareholder holding ≥10%; physical appearance is waived if the S.A.S. appoints a resident legal representative under an apostilled, notarized power of attorney registered with the Cámara de Comercio. The video call covers source of funds, intended FX volumes, trade counterparties, and ultimate beneficial owner identity; a branch meeting at Bogotá/Medellín/Barranquilla is an acceptable alternative for the sole signatory and accelerates corporate-account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single non-resident corporate shareholder wired contributor without physical Colombian substance (classic shell/booking-company red flag in underwriting).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Cámara de Comercio certificate of incorporation and S.A.S. bylaws (dated ≤30 days); (ii) Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) certificate obtained from DIAN per Resolution 164/2021 showing the ultimate natural persons; (iii) apostilled certificate of good standing of the parent/shareholder; (iv) shareholders' register (libro de accionistas) notarized copy; (v) corporate chart and commercial rationale memo for the Colombian S.A.S.; (vi) ID copies of all beneficial owners with ≥5% equity or control.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for the capital injection and first-year working capital, given S.A.S. minimum capital is not mandatory (red flag in SARLAFT risk scoring).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Audited financial statements of the investing parent (2 years); (ii) 3-month pre-funded bank statements of the remitting company; (iii) notarized Declaration of Origin of Funds (declaración de origen de fondos); (iv) supply contracts/pro-forma invoices for the bitumen inventory (drummed penetration-grade binder, ISIC 4661); (v) documented business plan with 12-month FX forecast; (vi) a statement of net-worth evolution reconciling with the RS Rest of the FX Form No. 4.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) status of shareholders, directors, or beneficial owners (transaction flag triggered by names matching public official databases).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Signed SFC-format PEP declarations for each owner and director; (ii) clearances against the public lists published by DIAN/SFC and the UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero); (iii) evidence of non-source-of-funds from public contracts; (iv) enhanced due-diligence questionnaire (for each PEP a wealth-and-income certification and the underlying asset traceability); (v) if a PEP is present, notification to the bank's Oficial de Cumplimiento and expectation of EDD monitoring for an initial 12-month period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/OFAC geography and petroleum-product provenance: bitumen originated from or traded via high-risk regimes (e.g., Venezuela, Iran) or shipped from ports under enhanced country-risk flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Full chain-of-custody file: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, weight certificate and Certificate of Analysis (COA) evidencing penetration grade; (ii) Certificate of Origin from the refinery/supplier; (iii) sanctions screening results (OFAC/UN/UE consolidated lists) for the counterparty and vessels; (iv) an independent sanctions-compliance legal opinion; (v) DIAN Import Declaration (Declaración de Importación) when goods clear; (vi) proof of payment routing exclusively through a Colombian IMC with the FX Form No. 1.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce of the registered business address, filed through the Unified Business and Social Registry (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year on or before 31 March; the official renewal tariff is asset-tier based and the reflected fee is a minimum-tier estimate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal after 31 March triggers a 10% surcharge on the applicable renewal tariff; repeated non-renewal prevents issuance of certificates of existence and representation, may subject the company to administrative strike-off by the Chamber of Commerce, and bars registry updates until the obligation is cured.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approval and filing (with management report where required)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders in ordinary meeting; minutes recorded in the corporate minute book and financial statements filed with the Chamber of Commerce/RUES as part of the annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year end, i.e. on or before 31 March of each year for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve and file financial statements by the annual meeting deadline blocks the annual renewal process and exposes legal representatives to fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades under Law 222 of 1995.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to the DIAN tax calendar based on the last two digits of the company's NIT, normally due in August of the year following the taxable year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing generates an extemporaneous filing penalty of 5% per month or fraction of month on tax payable, subject to a 100% tax cap, plus default interest; continued non-filing may lead to DIAN official assessment and additional penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner report (Información de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the date fixed by DIAN in the official tax calendar; a no-change confirmation is also mandatory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, incomplete filing, or incorrect UBO information may be penalized with fines up to 15,000 UVT per report under the Colombian Tax Code, in addition to potential registry negative consequences.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory independent auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory where total assets or gross ordinary income at the close of the prior fiscal year exceed 30,000 UVT, or where the S.A.S.'s by-laws require it; entities below this threshold are not statutorily required to appoint a Revisor Fiscal unless another law mandates it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF/IFRS as adopted under Law 1314 of 2009); a non-public S.A.S. generally applies NIIF para Pymes (IFRS for SMEs), while larger or publicly interested entities apply full NIIF.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: An annual UBO confirmation must be filed with DIAN even when no shareholding changes have occurred. Any transfer of shares during the year that creates, changes, or extinguishes beneficial ownership must be recorded in the shareholders' register and reflected in the next annual DIAN UBO confirmation; failure to update the UBO record after a qualifying share transfer may expose the company to fines and may make the transfer ineffective against third parties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members/Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Shareholders' Meeting Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Board of Directors' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, where applicable)
Share Transfer and Capital Contributions Register

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general corporate income tax rate for fiscal years 2023 onwards under Law 2277 of 2022; previously 35% for 2023-2025)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory incentives: (1) 50% tax credit for investments in science, technology, and innovation (STI) projects, applied against net taxable income; (2) 100% deduction for investments in fixed productive assets and for payroll costs of new employees under 28 or over 60 (120% for small taxpayers); (3) 20% corporate rate for taxpayers domiciled in registered Free Trade Zones (Zona Franca) — rarely available to plain distribution companies; (4) VAT discount on qualifying capital goods used in productive activities; note: the 3% surcharge (sobretasa) applies only to oil, coal, and energy generation sectors and does not apply to bitumen wholesale trading.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite carryforward under Law 1819/2016 and subsequent amendments; annual offset cap of 3% of net taxable income for large taxpayers in fiscal years 2024-2026 (5% for FY2023); small and medium taxpayers below 160,000 UVT of gross income may offset losses without the annual cap.
